roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
roles.summary: Led programming-language tooling and cross-chain integrations, contributed to an AI website builder, and led developer experience products.
roles.content:
Worked across product engineering, language tooling, developer experience, and ecosystem research at DFINITY Foundation. Contributed to Caffeine.ai, an AI website builder, and adopted agentic AI tools including Copilot, Cursor, and Antigravity to accelerate engineering work.

- Led Motoko language tooling, including a VS Code extension, formatter, live-reload development server, package manager, embed service, and compiler browser support (Node.js, TypeScript, Docker, WebAssembly).
- Led cross-chain EVM integrations and an observability dashboard using Rust and Grafana.
- Built the Developer Experience Feedback Board with React, Tailwind, Vite, and Next.js.
- Led design of a standard library optimized for LLM code generation, including big data analysis using Langfuse and Databricks.
- Conducted UX surveys and generative and evaluative studies.
- Analyzed Motoko source code on GitHub with Python to inform language design.
- Mentored community developer grant recipients.

The VS Code extension reached more than 85,000 installs.

roles.title: Freelance Software Consultant
roles.summary: Delivered full-stack Progressive Web Apps and custom web products for startups and small businesses.
roles.content:
Consulted with startups and small businesses on web technology, product requirements, and implementation. Specialized in full-stack Progressive Web Apps built with React, Tailwind or Bootstrap, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Webpack, and Workbox.

Projects ranged from client-facing applications to data-rich tools, with an emphasis on translating business needs into dependable and usable software.

roles.title: Research Assistant
roles.company: University of Colorado Boulder, College of Engineering & Applied Science
roles.summary: Worked on Adapton, an incremental computing system, and built a Rust visualization tool for research on typed incremental computation.
roles.content:
Worked with Dr. Matthew Hammer on a programming language for Adapton, an incremental computing system.

Developed an online visualization tool for the paper "Fungi: Typed incremental computation with names," using Rust and programming language theory.

roles.title: Web Systems Developer
roles.summary: Built custom full-stack web applications with distinctive design styles for local businesses.
roles.content: Designed and developed custom web applications for local businesses, combining full-stack implementation with tailored visual design.

roles.title: Information Technology Intern
roles.summary: Built a bus tracking and route viewer, designed REST APIs, improved CI/CD workflows, and mentored the software intern team across four summers.
roles.content:
- Developed a full-stack bus tracking and route viewer for the school district website using Java, Spring MVC, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML5.
- Provided technical leadership and mentoring for the software intern team across four summers.
- Designed REST APIs and improved CI/CD workflows using Vagrant, Chef, Erlang, and Ruby.

projects.title: Motoko Language Tooling
projects.summary: A suite of tools that made the Motoko programming language easier to write, test, preview, and embed.
projects.content:
Led development of programming language tooling, including the VS Code extension, formatter, live-reload development server, embed service, starter projects, and compiler browser support.

The extension grew to more than 85,000 installs. The tooling connected editor workflows with browser and Node.js environments using TypeScript and WebAssembly.

projects.title: Developer Experience Feedback Board
projects.summary: Built a full-stack feedback product to support developer experience research and prioritization.
projects.content: Contributed full-stack engineering to a feedback board for the developer community. The product used React, Tailwind, Vite, and Next.js and supported user research through surveys and evaluative studies.

projects.title: Fungi Incremental Computation Visualizer
projects.summary: An online visualization tool for the paper 'Fungi: Typed incremental computation with names.'
projects.content: Built an interactive visualization tool in Rust to accompany research on typed incremental computation with names. The project made the programming language output explorable in a browser.

projects.title: Full-stack Progressive Web Apps
projects.summary: Built mobile-friendly web applications for startups and small businesses.
projects.content:
Designed and implemented full-stack PWAs with React, Tailwind, Node.js, Webpack, and Workbox.

The work covered product interfaces and backend services, from stakeholder requirements through deploying application features.

projects.title: Bus Tracking and Route Viewer
projects.summary: A full-stack bus tracking and route viewer service developed for a school district website.
projects.content: Developed a public-facing bus tracking and route viewer using Java, Spring MVC, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML5 for Douglas County School District in Colorado.

projects.title: PandasGPT
projects.summary: A Python library for querying, transforming, and visualizing pandas DataFrames with ChatGPT or other large language models.
projects.content:
Pandas GPT brings natural-language requests into a pandas workflow. Use `df.ask(...)` to transform data, answer questions with tables, or create visualizations, with options to preview generated code or allow changes to the original DataFrame.

The library supports configurable model backends, including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and LiteLLM providers such as Gemini, Hugging Face, and OpenRouter. Custom completers are also supported.

[GitHub repository](https://github.com/rvanasa/pandas-gpt) · [Medium article](https://levelup.gitconnected.com/pandas-gpt-power-up-your-data-science-workflow-with-ai-dataframe-queries-868515d798f0) · [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/pandas-gpt/) · [Google Colab demo](https://colab.research.google.com/github/rvanasa/pandas-gpt/blob/main/notebooks/pandas_gpt_demo.ipynb)

projects.title: Mesoview
projects.summary: A modern, mobile-optimized interface for SPC mesoanalysis, used by storm chasers.
projects.content:
Mesoview ([skychaser.mesoview.app](https://skychaser.mesoview.app)) is a mobile-friendly interface for viewing Storm Prediction Center mesoanalysis products. It improves on the usability of the official website and has gained traction in the storm chasing community.

The interface supports stacked parameter panels (for example 500 mb heights alongside surface vorticity and 0-3 km MLCAPE), time navigation, regional sectors, and shareable views.

projects.title: Stepwise CAPE/CIN
projects.summary: Designed and contributed an inflow layer visualization to the SounderPy sounding plot package.
projects.content: Designed and contributed a stepwise CAPE/CIN inflow layer visualization to SounderPy, a Python package used to generate sounding plots for meteorology research papers. The visualization helps determine whether an environment is likely to produce surface-based or elevated thunderstorms.

projects.title: Cloud Inversion Forecast
projects.summary: A model-driven fog and cloud inversion forecast tool used by photographers in Colorado.
projects.content: Built a forecast app that combines high-resolution model output (HRRR, RAP, NAMNest) to predict fog, low clouds, and cloud inversions at selected viewpoints. It spread by word of mouth among Colorado photographers and is also used for my own weather photography.

projects.title: Mountain Wave Visualization
projects.summary: A custom cross-section tool for analyzing mountain waves and downslope windstorms.
projects.content: Built a cross-section visualization tool for studying terrain-driven mountain waves, used to analyze downslope wind events such as the December 2021 Marshall Fire windstorm and the 2025 Los Angeles area wildfires.

projects.title: RimCities
projects.summary: A RimWorld mod that procedurally generates explorable city maps with 200k+ subscribers.
projects.content:
RimCities adds procedurally generated cities to RimWorld, turning map generation into a way to explore the remains of past settlements.

[Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1775170117) · [Source code](https://github.com/rvanasa/rimworld-cities) · [Announcement](https://www.reddit.com/r/RimWorld/comments/c2odfh/10_rimcities_beta_release_procedural_city_map/)

projects.title: Skychaser
projects.summary: A global, community-powered database for sharing, browsing, and mapping photos of clouds, storms, and other sky phenomena.
projects.content:
[Skychaser](https://skychaser.mesoview.app) is a global database of sky and weather observations. Users submit photos with time and location details, then browse reports on a map or in a feed.

Community-suggested tags help researchers and enthusiasts annotate cloud formations, storms, auroras, and other sky phenomena.

education.content: Completed a Bachelor of Science in Creative Technology & Design at the University of Colorado Boulder, with a focus on software development and user experience research.

profile.name: Ryan Vandersmith
profile.tagline: R&D software engineer building forecasting, visualization, and analysis tools for meteorology and atmospheric science.
profile.summary: Ryan Vandersmith is an R&D software engineer with over 10 years of experience and a deep self-taught background in meteorology. He builds weather forecasting and analysis tools used by photographers, storm chasers, and researchers, including Mesoview (skychaser.mesoview.app), a cloud inversion forecast tool, a mountain wave visualization tool, and a stepwise CAPE/CIN contribution to SounderPy. Professionally, he worked on Caffeine.ai, an AI website builder, and led Motoko programming-language tooling, including a VS Code extension with more than 85,000 installs. He also has experience with cross-chain EVM integrations, developer-experience products, UX research, Rust research software at the University of Colorado Boulder, consulting, and public-sector software.
expertise: weather forecasting and atmospheric analysis tools
MetPy, Siphon, Xarray, NumPy, and Pandas
